articles.title: SOA Research: Climate Risk and Insurance Actuarial Perspectives 2026
articles.summary: SOA research report on climate risk modeling for insurance pricing and reserving. Covers scenario analysis, mortality/morbidity impacts, and transition risk frameworks.

articles.title: IFRS S2 Climate Disclosure: Implications for Actuaries
articles.summary: Analysis of IFRS S2 climate disclosure requirements and their impact on actuarial practice, including reporting obligations for insurers.

articles.title: Parametric Insurance for Climate Adaptation in Developing Economies
articles.summary: World Bank brief on parametric insurance products for climate adaptation, including weather index insurance and catastrophe bonds.

articles.title: NGFS Climate Scenarios for Financial Risk Assessment
articles.summary: Updated climate scenarios from the Network for Greening the Financial System, relevant for actuarial stress testing.

articles.title: IPCC AR6: Implications for Actuarial Assumptions
articles.summary: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report findings relevant to actuarial assumptions: sea level rise, extreme weather frequency.

executive_summary:
Across 13 filtered items, evidence concentrated on climate disclosure frameworks, parametric insurance innovation, and updated climate scenarios.

Pillar A site changes include new climate risk publications, insurance regulation updates, and IPCC meeting announcements.

Pillar B intelligence highlights SOA's climate risk research, IFRS S2 implications for actuaries, NGFS scenario updates, and World Bank's parametric insurance work.

Recurring actuarial implications include: disclosure and reporting obligations under IFRS S2, scenario analysis updates for pricing and reserving, and growth of parametric insurance markets for climate adaptation.
